description: <base target="_blank" href="/foo/">: critical only recognises href as the FIRST attribute of <base>, so it ignores this base; the HTML spec honours it.

thin.note: Spec <base href> handling: the base is honoured wherever href sits in the attribute list, so the sheet is fetched from /foo/css/a.css (expected-thin.css). critical resolves the href against the page directory instead and fetches /css/a.css (expected.css).
